errorMessage: The property 'Count' cannot be found on this object. Verify that the property exists.
rootCause: Under Set-StrictMode, Get-UnityProcesses emits no pipeline object when zero matching Unity processes exist. The frozen supervisor calls (Get-UnityProcesses ...).Count, so the zero-process healthy precondition becomes null and direct Count access fails.
minimumProspectiveRepair: In a new supervisor version, array-wrap each Get-UnityProcesses invocation at the call site before reading Count; repeat implementation freeze, independent static validation, algorithm-free readiness and final freeze in fresh evidence roots before requesting a new collection attempt.
